describes: the shape of the seam-handshake algorithm, not its calibrated parameters — band and yaw-time are the receiver's context, settable and learnable; they are readings, not the contract
steps: the sender projects a typed profile of the payload (completeness, substance, confidence-by-aspect); it describes, it does not decide delivery
the envelope crosses the seam and nothing else crosses — no state references
the receiver re-measures the payload with its own questions and decides comparatively, against the pool of candidates competing for its attention this round
the deadband (band, yaw-time) is applied to how far acting on the pick would move the receiver from its predicted course
a divergence between sender profile and receiver measurement beyond the declared tolerance is recorded verbatim with both measurements, never averaged
ending_rule: exactly one ending per transmission (MUTATE, MOVE, COPY, PROJECT); COPY is never a default and must be attributed
response_rule: a response that travels back (refusal profile, clarify question) is itself booked as a crossing in the reverse direction
pool_rule: the comparative pick is the best merit in the pool; a decided transmission id never re-enters the pool
agreement_rule: a crossing counts as shared only where both books' bookings agree on transmission id, payload hash, and cited contract version
